units.rawText: Gin can be used in so many ways. The "possibilities" are endless.

units.rawText: At first glance it may not seem like anything special, but it serves as the base for numerous high-end cocktails favored by partygoers. Perhaps the person who manufactured me had thought the same.

units.rawText: Infinite "possibilities". Even if those possibilities don't amount to anything... A meaningless passion, as it were.
